sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1992
ACT II OF 1992
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY
(POWERS,
IMMUNITIES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities
and Privileges) Act, 1988
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th February, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/3041,
dated 16-2-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly
(Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1992 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 2nd
February, 1992 and assented to by the Government of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 12th February, 1992, is hereby published as an Act, of the
Provincial Legislature of North -West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement: --(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 31st day of December,
1991.
